events.title: Meet the Crab! 🦀
events.summary: 🦀 Meet the Crab!Surviving on your island is about to get a little more interesting.I'm working on a new enemy system for Survindust, featuring different enemy types and new ways to deal with them.⚔️ Fight — Defeat your enemies and collect their loot.⛓️ Capture — Spare them and put them to work instead.First up is the Crab! This is just the beginning, with more enemy types to come.Community You can also join the Discord for news, updates, and small previews: Join here: https://discord.gg/jnDhCFmN

events.title: Survindust: Development Update & Demo News!
events.summary: Hi everyone! I’ve been working hard on Survindust, focusing on evolving the gameplay and making the core mechanics as stable as possible. The game is taking shape exactly how I envisioned it, and I’m making sure every detail feels right. The big news: A Demo is coming! I’m currently polishing the first playable version to give you a true taste of this survival experience. My priority is quality; I want to make sure everything is rock-solid and fun before I hit that 'release' button for the demo.
